label: Example planning rules from news reports plus stated assumptions. Confirm every value with DLH before operational use.

shifts.label: DLH confirms three shifts (morning, afternoon, night); the clock windows are assumed.

truck_limits.label: Example from Satpel LH Pasar Rebo: six 10 t tippers doing about 2 trips each per day. Confirm with DLH.

pasar_rebo.label: example quota (news report), confirm with DLH

default.label: No published quota for this kecamatan: no rit cap is applied (only the gate and facility limits bind). Confirm with DLH.

capacity_share.label: Gate and facility caps are citywide. A plan that covers only some kecamatan gets the pro-rata share of each cap by its share of the citywide forecast tonnage.

accepts.label: No vehicle-type restriction found in the sources.

rules.label: Post-landslide receiving capacity of about 900 rit/day (secondary source, not re-fetched).
rules.note: The 900 rit/day figure comes from a Babelinsight report seen in search results; the linked report gives the pre-landslide inflow of about 1,200 trips/day.

rules.label: "400 trucks per shift" comes from an opinion piece, so it is treated as an estimate.
Controlled-landfill roadmap: processed residue is 25% of what Bantargebang receives from 1 Aug 2026.
rules.planner_effect: Raw (unprocessed) waste trips are capped at (1 - residue share) of the daily rit cap.
